score_sheet_ref: 开发相关文档/阶段报告/AI大数据改造/V2/S01-评价评分表.md
scoring_unit: 每个(case_id,criterion_id)只计一次；issue_type另作定位解释。C02判行分类，C03判分类后的计数，C04判对有效已知值的累加，不重复计上游错误造成的下游数值症状。

scoring_policy.tp: 冻结问题criterion被标fail且J1确认对应证据成立，每单元最多1次
scoring_policy.fn: 冻结9个问题中未正确指出；标对但证据不成立仍为FN
scoring_policy.fp: 冻结69个正确单元被标fail；裁判不能豁免
scoring_policy.actionability: 9个错误例全部参与；漏报固定0；abstain/invalid为未评分并使评价未完成，不缩分母
scoring_policy.unresolved: 保留原始材料与未解决项，不无限重试或强行判通过
scoring_policy.claim: 固定案例规则校验与AI裁判辅助评价；非人工双评、教师认可或教学效果

deterministic_definitions.TP: known fail cell: candidate verdict=fail and J1 status=scored with evidence_valid=true; each case_id/criterion_id once
deterministic_definitions.FN: 9 - TP; matching label with unsupported evidence remains FN
deterministic_definitions.FP: known pass cell with candidate verdict=fail, regardless of J1 explanation
deterministic_definitions.false_positive_rate: FP/69; FP <= 3 and precision also required
deterministic_definitions.unknown_cells: 18 excluded from 69 known-pass denominator; all three insufficient cases overall=insufficient and six verdicts unknown; no unsupported definitive claims
deterministic_definitions.incorrect_pass: known nine incorrect case overall=pass; gate zero
deterministic_definitions.correct_confirmation: four known correct case overall=pass; gate at least three
deterministic_definitions.actionability: all nine incorrect cases stay denominator; any FN cell in the case => fixed 0; scored valid J1 score otherwise; abstain/invalid unresolved remains unscored, do not discard; at least eight scores>=2 and sum>=18
deterministic_definitions.invalid_or_exception: any missing/invalid model response, exception, unresolved judge item or failed/missing calibration => full evaluation not completed
